blocking: Phone (390px): the fixed Pause button covers the Email input at rest (index-phone-3.jpg, button 16–52px x over the input that starts at 40px) and the footer's Instagram link (index-phone-4.jpg). The hide-while-scrolling and 64px/56px reserves only help at the very bottom; this breaks the owner's hard rule that controls never cover inputs, text or the footer.

fixes.where: site.js, the `if (tab && panel && backdrop)` block (hww panel) + canopy.css phone rules
fixes.what: Move the motionBtn hide-while-scrolling logic and the headerInquire ghost toggle out of the hww-tab block into their own block that runs when `.motion-toggle` exists (index has no tab, so neither runs there). On phones also give .form, .inquire__call and .site-footer address a left padding of 56px below 769px, or move the Pause button to bottom-right where the form's left edge is not.
fixes.why: On index the header Inquire stays gold while the form's gold button is on screen (index-desktop-4.jpg) and the Pause button sits over the Email field and footer links on phones.

fixes.where: index.html `.tree__canopy img` and the other four tree-full.webp s + the preload
fixes.what: Add a 768-wide variant (assets/tree/tree-full-768.webp, ~120 KB) with srcset="tree-full-768.webp 768w, tree-full.webp 1536w" sizes="(max-width:768px) 120vw, 100vw" and `imagesrcset`/`imagesizes` on the preload link.
fixes.why: A 491 KB, 1536×3714 image is preloaded at high priority on a 390px phone that renders it 468px wide; it competes with the logo, fonts and poster for the first paint.

fixes.what: Add `.js.anim-ready .canopy .hero__rise{opacity:0}` (and `.reduced .hero__rise{opacity:1}`), and have the rise tween use `gsap.to(rise,{opacity:1,...})` instead of fromTo from opacity 0.
fixes.why: Deferred scripts run after first paint: the logo and line paint, snap to opacity 0, then rise — a visible flash on every load with a warm cache.

fixes.what: Remove `will-change` from `.tree` (GSAP's transform already promotes it) and keep it only on `.tree__canopy`, `.tree__shake` and the two sprigs; let the band stay a plain repeat-y background without its own layer.
fixes.why: `.tree` is a composited layer the full page height (≈1440×3500 px at desktop, plus five decoded copies of the same image); on phones that is tens of MB of GPU texture for a 0.1× parallax.

fixes.what: Lower the hero's canopy start to ~70% of screen 1 (`--tree-top:calc(var(--vh100) * .7 - 169 * var(--s))`) or shrink the gap after row 1270 so the statement's eyebrow enters the viewport before the canopy's underside leaves it; verify at 1366×657 and 1440×900.
fixes.why: index-desktop-1.jpg is a full 900px viewport of canopy with no copy at all (statement begins at page y≈1700): a dead scroll screen between the hero and the first words.

fixes.where: index.html `<head>`: the two stylesheets; site.js block 8 on phones
fixes.what: Concatenate canopy.css into site.css for the home build (or inline it) and skip `buildLeaves()` for leaves that are `display:none` (`getComputedStyle(leaf).display==='none'`).
fixes.why: One extra render-blocking CSS request on the only page that matters for LCP, and four ScrollTriggers scrubbing invisible leaves on every phone scroll frame.
